say:4:1910136003:1.text: Yep! We always go hunting as a whole family.
say:4:1910136003:1.source_cn: 是呀，我们一向都是全家人一起去捕猎的。

say:5:1910136008:0.text: Especially now, with the <style="highlight">renewal season</style> coming up! We'll need lots of supplies to nurture the next generation.

choice_prompt:7:1910136009.text: During a time like this, everyone has to pitch in.

say:8:1910136010:1.text: Yup! It's the most important time of the year for us. It's when all the Shallowsea families <style="highlight">welcome new life</style> into the world!

say:9:1910136011:1.text: Bringing new family into the world takes serious preparation, so we gather plenty of nourishment beforehand.
say:9:1910136011:1.source_cn: 繁衍是最重要的事情，需要提前准备很多物资作为养料。

say:10:1910136012:1.text: Once renewal season begins, the Tidewarden guides Coralia up from our usual place into shallower waters, where there's more to gather.
say:10:1910136012:1.source_cn: 所以在洄游季开始时，波涛长者会先带着塔拉萨从平时停留的...

say:11:1910136013:1.text: After we've gathered enough, Coralia goes deeper into the Middlesea. The water is much calmer and warmer there, perfect for welcoming our new family members.
say:11:1910136013:1.source_cn: 等到我们获得了足够的物资，塔拉萨才会下潜至比平时更深一...

say:12:1910136014:1.text: That's how Tolan found my family! Otherwise, he'd have had to swim a loooong way to reach us.
say:12:1910136014:1.source_cn: 正因为这样，图澜才能找到我家呀！不然，他要游好长好长一...

say:13:1910136015:1.text: I took the Waterstrider. No swimming needed.

choice_prompt:14:1910136015.text: I took the Waterstrider. No swimming needed.

say:15:1910136016:1.text: Oh, no! The Tidewarden decides when to ascend and descend. But it's super reliable! It's never gotten the timing of the renewal season wrong!
say:15:1910136016:1.source_cn: 上浮和下潜都是波涛长者自己的行动，不过它很厉害，从没有...

say:16:1910136017:1.text: We don't know exactly when it'll dive, but there are always signs. The currents get stronger, and even the smaller sea creatures start to leave. Oh, and the Tidewarden gives us a call to warn us too!
say:16:1910136017:1.source_cn: 虽然我们不知道下潜的具体时间，但每次下潜之前都会有特定...

say:17:1910136018:1.text: So we have to make the most of the time we have before it dives and gather as much nourishment as possible.
say:17:1910136018:1.source_cn: 所以，我们得抓紧时间，在下潜之前的这段日子里多多采集物...

say:18:1910136019:1.text: Especially my family, the Seamoon Clan! We're welcoming a new family member this year, so everyone needs to pitch in.
say:18:1910136019:1.source_cn: 尤其是我们海月家族。今年家里要增加新的家人，所有人都必...

say:19:1910136020:1.text: Do you really not know any of this?
say:19:1910136020:1.source_cn: 咦，你们真的一点也不知道这些事吗？

say:22:1910136022:1.text: Hmm... I guess our worlds really are different! Now I'm even more curious about life on land! You've gotta tell me everything later.
say:22:1910136022:1.source_cn: 唔……看来我们的差异真的很大。我对你们的事越来越好奇了...

say:23:1910136023:1.text: But first, I've got a hunt to join! If you're curious, why don't you come with me?
say:23:1910136023:1.source_cn: 现在我得去参加围猎啦。对了，要是你们好奇的话，就跟我一...
